notes._summary: Approved cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 divergence baseline after issue #144. Of the 58 semantic / 29 visual failures recorded on main, the parser/renderer fixes in this change (GFM table thead/tbody + align attribute, task-list trailing-space normalization via shared list-child renderer, GFM bare-URL/email autolink postprocess with image-alt and code-node skipping, GFM single+double-tilde strikethrough, embedded-HTML-in-table-cell via coherent inline-to-HTML serialization, GFM tagfilter for the Disallowed Raw HTML / HTML tag filter sections, and per-case autolink gating for the CommonMark-core Autolinks section) resolve 44 semantic / 23 visual cases. The 14 semantic / 6 visual cases below remain and are tracked here as documented divergence rather than regressions; each is either a deliberate spec-correct stance or out-of-scope future work.
notes.spec-0398: Emphasis: cmark 0.29 emits flat output where the CommonMark emphasis algorithm (delimiter runs, rule of 3) mandates nesting. Supramark's parser is spec-correct; matching cmark 0.29 would require reintroducing the known cmark emphasis bug. See issue #144 (emphasis divergence).
notes.spec-0426: Emphasis: same cmark-0.29 flat-vs-nested divergence as spec-0398; parser is spec-correct.

notes.spec-0652: Disallowed Raw HTML: GFM tagfilter escapes disallowed block-level tags at the point of emission, but this case requires HTML tree-construction leak-through (an unclosed disallowed tag in one block leaking into the next block's parsing). The React-based web renderer emits blocks as independent elements and cannot reproduce cmark-gfm's active-formatting-element reconstruction across block boundaries. Tracked as future work.
notes.extensions-0020: Autolink crash-safety edge case `(_A_@_.A` renders as the cmark-gfm internal `<IGNORE>` sentinel. This is a cmark-gfm implementation detail, not a real rendering target; tracked as an excluded case.
